Triage: lands in `domain:ui` (and the plugin-security permission floor) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Bug · the maintainer ruled that anyone who can read a record can mark its discussion resolved (7063285032), but after #36104 an ordinary member resolving another member's thread is refused 403 by the `owner_only_writes` floor; the tests of #36104 ran without the security service; a plain update grant would also let members edit others' comment bodies, so the fix waits on an open maintainer question → p2 as filed · size S once answered. repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T22:01Z · comment write permissions found by the review of PR #36178 (reviewed by fable first, `build-seat1/36075/pr2/fable-decisions.md` in the project folder)

At 2026-11-21T21:59Z the maintainer answered two seat decision cards:

1. 「能编辑记录的同事，可以改别人评论的文字吗？」: option 0, 「只有作者能改」. A comment's text stays author-only for ordinary members; administrators are unchanged. So this card takes the **dedicated resolve door**: a server-side path that writes only the resolution fields (`is_resolved`, `resolved_by`, `resolved_at`) after checking the caller can read the parent record, with the `owner_only_writes` floor left as it is. The one-line `sys_comment` update twin is ruled out, because it would also let record editors rewrite others' comments. Tests must show a member's body edit of another member's comment is still refused.
2. 「普通成员能删自己的评论吗？」: option 0, 「加删自己评论的入口」. Members may delete their own comments and not others'. That is a separate backend card (own-row delete door), filed next; the console then offers Delete on one's own comments.

Ruling 7063285032 (any reader may resolve) stands and is what this card delivers.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T22:08Z · #36186, folded with #36191 into one PR (two server-side comment doors, maintainer ruling 7069889899 on #36186).
Area: b1-CM (epic #36062)
Session: `session_01L6bhgUH1jEKbDzYRc4nghq` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-bvfzy8 (from main 6c7c6db2)
File surface: plugin-audit comment routes beside the existing unreact door (two new doors and their census rows), the resolution stamp's attribution, the console's comment wiring in plugin-detail and app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx` (comment handlers only), a new affordance row, tests, docs, changeset.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening): two new REST routes and a new affordance row.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, file `build-seat1/36186-36191/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds.
Scope, the seat's reading:
- #36186, door A: `PUT /api/v1/comments/:id/resolution` takes only `{resolved}`; it admits a caller who can read the comment as themselves (ruling 7063285032: anyone who can see the record, which includes any external member who can read it), refuses a reply with 400, writes only `is_resolved` through a system write, and stamps `resolved_by` as the caller. The `owner_only_writes` floor, `sys_comment_moderation` and the data route's resolve branch are unchanged; no `sys_comment` update twin (comment text stays author-only, ruling 7069889899). The console's ✓ always calls door A; the explain probe stays for editing others' comments only.
- #36191, door B: `DELETE /api/v1/comments/:id` on the shared kit `own-row-delete-routes.ts`, owner column `author_id`. Administrators keep the data route.
- Deleting a top-level comment that has replies: door B refuses it (409, `DELETE_RESTRICTED`) and the console offers no Delete there (Edit stays). The seat reads this as following the ruling, not a new choice: 「删不了别人的」 rules out cascading the replies away, and today's `set_null` would rewrite other members' reply rows through a system write. Administrators are unchanged. Stated in the PR's 维护者速读.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: folded: same epic, same plugin, same ruling, same rig tests; overlap only with #36136 in another region of `RecordDetailView.tsx`. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. `check-governed-merges --test` expected 0 of 13 governed; contract L2 at the face the final paths decide; L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #36186` and `Fixes #36191`.
